name: Plantation
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Plantation, FL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Plantation, FL: Winter Wonderland at the museum, Santa at Plantation Walk, Breakfast With Santa and a library holiday concert.
lede: Plantation does Christmas with a hometown feel: a historical museum full of decorated trees, free Santa nights at Plantation Walk and a city Breakfast With Santa in a neighborhood park.
celebrates: The Plantation Historical Society fills the Plantation Historical Museum with more than 40 themed Christmas trees, a miniature train village and a holiday gift shop for its Winter Wonderland, and Santa sits down there on two Saturdays. Plantation Walk invites Santa Claus and his Mischievous Elves to its plaza on select nights, with live music from Thursday to Sunday and a free Polar Express movie night. The City of Plantation Parks and Recreation Department serves Breakfast With Santa at Volunteer Park, where pajamas are encouraged. West Regional Library adds a holiday concert in its multipurpose room.
lastyear: In 2025 the City of Plantation held Breakfast With Santa on Saturday, December 13, from 9 to 11 am at Volunteer Park. Tickets were $13 per person, and the city's calendar said pre-registration was required. The city's calendar also listed a Santa's Visit on Christmas Eve, December 24, 2025, from 5 pm to 9:59 pm at the Central Park Multi-Purpose Building. This year's breakfast price is $15, and the city asks families to register early.
facts: Plantation began with one man's plan. Frederick Peters moved his family to South Florida in 1931 to escape harsh Midwest winters and bought 10,000 acres along State Road 7/441. The city was incorporated on April 30, 1953, with a population of less than 500 and a budget of $1,288. Its motto, E Vasitate, Haec Urbs, means Out of the Wilderness, This City, and the volunteer fire department, founded in 1957, still holds a fundraising barbecue.
trains: Plantation does not have its own Tri-Rail station. The closest stops on Tri-Rail's Broward line include Cypress Creek and Fort Lauderdale, and the Fort Lauderdale Airport station is at 500 Gulf Stream Way in Dania. Metrorail and Metromover run in Miami-Dade County, so they are a longer trip from Broward. Kids who love trains can see the Plantation Historical Museum's miniature train village during Winter Wonderland. For a bigger train day, the Gold Coast Railroad Museum in Miami has over 40 historic rail cars, including the Presidential Rail Car Ferdinand Magellan and Florida East Coast Steam Locomotive #153.
train_links: Over 40 historic rail cars, including the Presidential car Ferdinand Magellan and Florida East Coast steam locomotive #153, in Miami.
traditions: The Plantation Historical Society decorates the museum with more than 40 themed trees and a miniature train village.
Santa and his Mischievous Elves take photos in the Plantation Walk Plaza on select nights, and the plaza is pet-friendly.
The city serves breakfast, an Elf Hide-and-Seek Adventure, crafts and games at Volunteer Park, and pajamas are encouraged.
Plantation Walk shows a Polar Express movie in the plaza for the whole family.
West Regional Library hosts a community holiday music afternoon with a meal from the Friends of the library.
kidfact: Plantation's city motto is in Latin and means Out of the Wilderness, This City. It reminds people that the city grew from open land far west of the first towns.
faq: Where can kids meet Santa in Plantation?

Kids can meet Santa at the Plantation Historical Museum on North Fig Tree Lane, in the Plantation Walk Plaza on select nights and at the city's Breakfast With Santa at Volunteer Park. Each host sets its own dates, so check the event page before you go. The museum and Plantation Walk list free admission, while the city's breakfast has a ticket price.
Is there a free Christmas event in Plantation?

Yes. Admission to the Plantation Historical Museum's Winter Wonderland is free, and Plantation Walk lists free admission and free parking for its Santa nights and its Polar Express movie night. West Regional Library's holiday musical event is also free. Always check each host's page for the current dates and times.
Does Plantation have a Christmas tree display?

The Plantation Historical Museum shows more than 40 Christmas trees, each decorated around a different theme, in its Winter Wonderland exhibit. The Plantation Historical Society says it is the museum's 41st year of the exhibit. A miniature train village and a holiday gift shop are part of the same visit.
Is Plantation Walk good for small kids at Christmas?

Plantation Walk invites families to meet Santa and his Mischievous Elves in its plaza and lists free admission and parking. The plaza is described as pet-friendly. It also shows a free Polar Express movie night for the entire family. Plantation Walk's restaurants and shops are open before and after the events.
How did Plantation get its name and motto?

Plantation grew from land that Frederick Peters bought along State Road 7/441, and the city was incorporated on April 30, 1953. The Latin motto E Vasitate, Haec Urbs translates into Out of the Wilderness, This City, according to the City of Plantation's history page.
sources: Out of the Wilderness, This City: Plantation's History
